_comment: Copy to classification.json and make it yours. verbs: posture is auto | ask | confirm-always | conditioned-auto (git push only). exec: the real argv the verb expands to (args appended). push_pins: repo folder name -> the owner/repo (or host) substring the origin URL must contain for conditioned-auto; '*' is the fallback pin.

git push._note: flip to conditioned-auto once the pin below is set and you trust the marker list

tracker-ping._note: replace exec with your own notification command (e.g. a Telegram bot script); a narrow reaches-only-you verb is the one safe always-allow
